_meta.purpose: Anthropologist persona + helpful/unhelpful axis.  The anthropologist is an academic-observer role with no professional obligation to give practical help on most life-advice questions, mirroring the chef_helpful_v1 'discretionary helpfulness' design that worked well.  Mixed with explicit help/no-help trade-off framings to give the steering vector multiple handles.

data/traits/instructions/unhelpful.json:: matched to one helpful-style question for symmetry
